pier.title: The last crossing
pier.prose: The ferry has already pulled in its rope. Through the fog, someone on the opposite bank rings a bell twice. The ferryman takes his hand off the throttle.

echo.title: An answer in brass
echo.prose: One low note follows the two high ones. From inside the wheelhouse, a child taps the same three notes against the glass.

deck.title: A hand on the throttle
deck.prose: The channel lights go out. Under your hand the rail begins to shake. The ferryman looks toward the dark landing and waits.

dawn.title: Open water
dawn.prose: The ferry clears the pier just before it slips into the channel. At first light, the child draws the old landing from memory.

raft.title: Room for one more
raft.prose: Two high notes and one low. A raft noses out from under the landing. The ferryman lowers a ladder, and the child finally lets go of the glass.
